component.name: TrayPrint
component.summary: Local Print Agent for Print Hub

description.p: TrayPrint is a system tray application that connects printers to your enterprise print management system. It runs in the background, automatically discovers printers via CUPS, and processes print jobs from Print Hub.

ul.li: System tray GUI with dark/light theme support
Real-time job queue with WebSocket updates
Headless server mode for service deployment

description.p: Initial Linux release with AppImage, DEB, and RPM packaging support.
